+import pygame
+from pathlib import Path
+from game import constants as C
+
+class Fighter:
+    """
+    Fighter represents a player or AI-controlled fighter.
+
+    Methods:
+    - update(dt: float, floor_y: int, target: 'Fighter'|None=None)
+    - draw(surface: pygame.Surface)
+    - punch() -> bool
+    - check_punch_hit(other: 'Fighter') -> bool
+    - take_damage(amount: int)
+    - apply_knockback(amount: float)
+
+    Attributes are kept public for simplicity (position via rect, health etc.).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, x: float, image_path: str, facing: str = 'right', is_ai: bool = False):
+        self.is_ai = is_ai
+        self.facing = facing  # 'left' or 'right'
+        self.image = pygame.image.load(image_path).convert_alpha()
+        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()
+        # anchor by midbottom to the given x; caller should set rect.midbottom after init
+        self.rect.centerx = int(x)
+        self.vx = 0.0
+        self.vy = 0.0
+
+        self.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+
+        # Punch state
+        self.is_punching = False
+        self.punch_timer = 0.0
+        # cooldown timer until can punch again
+        self.cooldown_timer = 0.0
+        self.punch_range = C.PUNCH_RANGE
+        self.punch_damage = C.PUNCH_DAMAGE
+        self.punch_hit_registered = False
+
+        # Flash when hit
+        self.flash_timer = 0.0
+
+    def rect_midbottom(self):
+        return self.rect.midbottom
+
+    def update(self, dt: float, floor_y: int, target: 'Fighter' = None):
+        """Update physics and AI. If target is provided and is_ai True, the fighter will move/punch toward target."""
+        # Apply gravity
+        self.vy += C.GRAVITY * dt
+        # Integrate position
+        self.rect.x += int(self.vx * dt)
+        self.rect.y += int(self.vy * dt)
+
+        # Floor collision
+        if self.rect.bottom >= floor_y:
+            self.rect.bottom = floor_y
+            # If falling, stop vertical velocity
+            if self.vy > 0:
+                self.vy = 0
+
+        # Timers
+        if self.is_punching:
+            self.punch_timer -= dt
+            if self.punch_timer <= 0:
+                self.is_punching = False
+                self.punch_timer = 0
+                # reset hit registration so future punches can hit
+                self.punch_hit_registered = False
+        if self.cooldown_timer > 0:
+            self.cooldown_timer -= dt
+            if self.cooldown_timer < 0:
+                self.cooldown_timer = 0
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            self.flash_timer -= dt
+            if self.flash_timer < 0:
+                self.flash_timer = 0
+
+        # AI behavior
+        if self.is_ai and target is not None:
+            self._ai_behavior(dt, target)
+
+    def _ai_behavior(self, dt: float, target: 'Fighter'):
+        # Walk toward the player
+        if target.rect.centerx < self.rect.centerx - 5:
+            # player is left
+            self.vx = -C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif target.rect.centerx > self.rect.centerx + 5:
+            self.vx = C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+        else:
+            self.vx = 0
+
+        # If close, attempt to punch
+        distance = abs(target.rect.centerx - self.rect.centerx)
+        if distance <= C.AI_PUNCH_DISTANCE and self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            # Start punch
+            self.punch()
+            # AI uses its cooldown
+            self.cooldown_timer = C.AI_PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+
+    def start_move(self, direction: str):
+        if direction == 'left':
+            self.vx = -C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif direction == 'right':
+            self.vx = C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+
+    def stop_move(self):
+        self.vx = 0
+
+    def jump(self):
+        # Only allow jump if on floor
+        if self.vy == 0:
+            self.vy = -C.JUMP_SPEED
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def punch(self) -> bool:
+        # Start punch if not in cooldown
+        if self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            self.is_punching = True
+            self.punch_timer = C.PUNCH_DURATION
+            # set cooldown (player and AI may have different cooldown handled by caller)
+            # register hit false until we actually hit
+            self.punch_hit_registered = False
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def check_punch_hit(self, other: 'Fighter') -> bool:
+        """Check whether this fighter's current punch hits the other. If it does, apply damage and knockback and return True."""
+        if not self.is_punching:
+            return False
+        if self.punch_hit_registered:
+            return False
+
+        # Build punch rect in front of fighter
+        if self.facing == 'right':
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.right, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+        else:
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.left - self.punch_range, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+
+        if punch_rect.colliderect(other.rect):
+            # Register hit so one punch only hits once
+            self.punch_hit_registered = True
+            other.take_damage(self.punch_damage)
+            # Knockback: per Plan, opponent x-position decreases if attacker facing right, increases if facing left
+            if self.facing == 'right':
+                other.apply_knockback(-C.KNOCKBACK)
+            else:
+                other.apply_knockback(C.KNOCKBACK)
+            # Flash other
+            other.flash_timer = C.FLASH_TIME
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def take_damage(self, amount: int):
+        self.health -= int(amount)
+        if self.health < 0:
+            self.health = 0
+
+    def apply_knockback(self, amount: float):
+        # Move the rect horizontally by amount pixels
+        self.rect.x += int(amount)
+
+    def draw(self, surface: pygame.Surface):
+        surface.blit(self.image, self.rect)
+        # Draw flash overlay if needed
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            overlay = pygame.Surface((self.rect.width, self.rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
+            overlay.fill((255, 255, 255, 160))
+            surface.blit(overlay, self.rect)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.health > 0

+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+import pygame
+from pathlib import Path
+from game import constants as C
+from game.fighter import Fighter
+
+ASSET_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'assets'
+
+
+def load_asset(name: str) -> str:
+    path = ASSET_DIR / name
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing asset: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+class Game:
+    def __init__(self):
+        pygame.init()
+        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.SCREEN_HEIGHT))
+        pygame.display.set_caption('Dojo Duel')
+        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
+        self.font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
+        self.big_font = pygame.font.Font(None, 72)
+
+        self.running = True
+        self.state = 'playing'  # 'playing' or 'ended'
+
+        # Input flags
+        self.moving_left = False
+        self.moving_right = False
+
+        self._load_assets()
+        self.init_game()
+
+    def _load_assets(self):
+        # Load fighter images paths
+        self.red_path = load_asset('red_belt_fighter.png')
+        self.blue_path = load_asset('blue_belt_fighter.png')
+
+    def init_game(self):
+        # Create fighters
+        # Player on left
+        player_x = 150
+        rival_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - 150
+        self.player = Fighter(player_x, self.red_path, facing='right', is_ai=False)
+        self.rival = Fighter(rival_x, self.blue_path, facing='left', is_ai=True)
+        # Anchor to floor
+        self.player.rect.midbottom = (player_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        self.rival.rect.midbottom = (rival_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+
+        # Reset additional state
+        self.player.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.rival.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.player.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.rival.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.player.is_punching = False
+        self.rival.is_punching = False
+        self.player.punch_timer = 0
+        self.rival.punch_timer = 0
+        self.player.flash_timer = 0
+        self.rival.flash_timer = 0
+
+        self.state = 'playing'
+        self.last_end_printed = False
+
+    def run(self):
+        while self.running:
+            dt = self.clock.tick(C.FPS) / 1000.0
+            self._handle_events()
+            if self.state == 'playing':
+                self._update(dt)
+                self._check_hits()
+                self._check_end()
+            self._draw()
+            pygame.display.flip()
+        pygame.quit()
+
+    def _handle_events(self):
+        for event in pygame.event.get():
+            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
+                print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                self.running = False
+                return
+            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
+                    print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                    self.running = False
+                    return
+                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
+                    # Restart
+                    print('RESTART', flush=True)
+                    self.init_game()
+                if self.state != 'playing':
+                    # When ended, only allow restart/quit
+                    continue
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = True
+                    self.player.start_move('left')
+                    print('MOVE LEFT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = True
+                    self.player.start_move('right')
+                    print('MOVE RIGHT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:
+                    if self.player.jump():
+                        print('JUMP', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
+                    started = self.player.punch()
+                    if started:
+                        # apply player cooldown
+                        self.player.cooldown_timer = C.PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+                        print('PUNCH', flush=True)
+            elif event.type == pygame.KEYUP:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = False
+                    # if right still held, move right
+                    if self.moving_right:
+                        self.player.start_move('right')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = False
+                    if self.moving_left:
+                        self.player.start_move('left')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+
+    def _update(self, dt: float):
+        # Update fighters
+        # Player update
+        self.player.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        # Rival update with AI
+        self.rival.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y, target=self.player)
+
+    def _check_hits(self):
+        # Player punch hits rival
+        if self.player.check_punch_hit(self.rival):
+            # Print damage event? Not required; health bar updates visually
+            pass
+        # Rival punch hits player
+        if self.rival.check_punch_hit(self.player):
+            pass
+
+    def _check_end(self):
+        if not self.rival.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('WIN', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+        elif not self.player.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('GAME OVER', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+
+    def _draw(self):
+        # Background
+        self.screen.fill(C.LIGHT_BG)
+        # Floor
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.WOOD_BROWN, (0, C.FLOOR_Y, C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.FLOOR_HEIGHT))
+
+        # Fighters
+        self.player.draw(self.screen)
+        self.rival.draw(self.screen)
+
+        # Health bars
+        # Player bar (left)
+        pb_x = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (pb_x, pb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_w = int((self.player.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_PLAYER, (pb_x, pb_y, player_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_text = self.font.render('Player', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(player_text, (pb_x, pb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # Rival bar (right)
+        rb_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN - C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH
+        rb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (rb_x, rb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_w = int((self.rival.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_RIVAL, (rb_x + (C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_w), rb_y, rival_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_text = self.font.render('Rival', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(rival_text, (rb_x + C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_text.get_width(), rb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # If ended, display message and freeze
+        if self.state == 'ended':
+            if not self.player.is_alive():
+                msg = 'GAME OVER'
+            else:
+                msg = 'WIN'
+            text_surf = self.big_font.render(msg, True, C.BLACK)
+            self.screen.blit(text_surf, ((C.SCREEN_WIDTH - text_surf.get_width()) // 2, (C.SCREEN_HEIGHT - text_surf.get_height()) // 2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    game = Game()
+    game.run()

Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title, main loop, input, health bars, floor, game state, restart/quit: game/main.py
  - Fighter behavior (movement, gravity, jump, punch, health, flash, knockback): game/fighter.py
  - Constants (sizes, colors, physics, timings): game/constants.py
  - Package init: game/__init__.py

- State ownership:
  - game/main.py owns global game state (state = 'playing'/'ended'), player and rival references, input flags, and lifecycle (init/restart/quit).
  - Fighter instances own position (x, y), velocities (vx, vy), health, attack timers, cooldowns, flash timers.
  - main.py calls Fighter methods: update(dt, floor_y), punch(), check_punch_hit(other), draw(surface).

- Interfaces (signatures):
  - Fighter.__init__(x: float, image_path: str, facing: str='right', is_ai: bool=False)
  - Fighter.update(dt: float, floor_y: int)
  - Fighter.draw(surface: pygame.Surface)
  - Fighter.punch() -> bool (True if punch started)
  - Fighter.check_punch_hit(other: Fighter) -> bool (True if hit this frame)
  - Fighter.take_damage(amount: int)
  - Fighter.apply_knockback(amount: float)

- Coordinate convention:
  - World uses pixels. Fighter.rect.midbottom is anchored to floor_y. Positive x to right, y increases downward.

- Lifecycle:
  - init_game() in main.py constructs fighters and resets health and timers.
  - Play: handle events -> update fighters (when state=='playing') -> check hits -> render -> flip.
  - Win/lose: when health <= 0, set state='ended', print "WIN" or "GAME OVER", freeze updates. R restarts (calls init_game), ESC quits.

+

+
+

+

+
+        # Input flags

+
+        self._load_assets()
+        self.init_game()
+
+    def _load_assets(self):
+        # Load fighter images paths
+        self.red_path = load_asset('red_belt_fighter.png')
+        self.blue_path = load_asset('blue_belt_fighter.png')
+
+    def init_game(self):
+        # Create fighters
+        # Player on left
+        player_x = 150
+        rival_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - 150
+        self.player = Fighter(player_x, self.red_path, facing='right', is_ai=False)
+        self.rival = Fighter(rival_x, self.blue_path, facing='left', is_ai=True)
+        # Anchor to floor
+        self.player.rect.midbottom = (player_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        self.rival.rect.midbottom = (rival_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+
+        # Reset additional state

+        self.rival.health = C.MAX_HEALTH

+        self.rival.cooldown_timer = 0

+        self.rival.is_punching = False
+        self.player.punch_timer = 0
+        self.rival.punch_timer = 0
+        self.player.flash_timer = 0
+        self.rival.flash_timer = 0
+
+        self.state = 'playing'
+        self.last_end_printed = False
+
+    def run(self):
+        while self.running:
+            dt = self.clock.tick(C.FPS) / 1000.0
+            self._handle_events()
+            if self.state == 'playing':
+                self._update(dt)
+                self._check_hits()
+                self._check_end()
+            self._draw()
+            pygame.display.flip()
+        pygame.quit()
+
+    def _handle_events(self):
+        for event in pygame.event.get():
+            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
+                print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                self.running = False
+                return
+            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
+                    print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                    self.running = False
+                    return
+                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
+                    # Restart
+                    print('RESTART', flush=True)
+                    self.init_game()
+                if self.state != 'playing':
+                    # When ended, only allow restart/quit
+                    continue
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = True
+                    self.player.start_move('left')
+                    print('MOVE LEFT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = True
+                    self.player.start_move('right')
+                    print('MOVE RIGHT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:

+            elif event.type == pygame.KEYUP:

+                    self.moving_left = False
+                    # if right still held, move right
+                    if self.moving_right:
+                        self.player.start_move('right')

+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = False

+                        self.player.start_move('left')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+
+    def _update(self, dt: float):
+        # Update fighters
+        # Player update
+        self.player.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        # Rival update with AI
+        self.rival.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y, target=self.player)
+
+    def _check_hits(self):

+            pass
+
+    def _check_end(self):

+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('GAME OVER', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+
+    def _draw(self):
+        # Background
+        self.screen.fill(C.LIGHT_BG)
+        # Floor
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.WOOD_BROWN, (0, C.FLOOR_Y, C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.FLOOR_HEIGHT))
+
+        # Fighters
+        self.player.draw(self.screen)

+
+        # Health bars

+        pb_x = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN

+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_PLAYER, (pb_x, pb_y, player_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_text = self.font.render('Player', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(player_text, (pb_x, pb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # Rival bar (right)
+        rb_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN - C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH
+        rb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN

+
+        # If ended, display message and freeze

+            else:
+                msg = 'WIN'

        self.flash_timer = 0.0

        self.rect.y += int(self.vy * dt)

            if self.vy > 0:

        # Walk toward the player
        if target.rect.centerx < self.rect.centerx - 5:
            # player is left
            self.vx = -C.AI_SPEED
            self.facing = 'left'
        elif target.rect.centerx > self.rect.centerx + 5:
            self.vx = C.AI_SPEED
            self.facing = 'right'
        else:

        elif direction == 'right':

            # Knockback: per Plan, opponent x-position decreases if attacker facing right, increases if facing left

            else:
                other.apply_knockback(C.KNOCKBACK)
            # Flash other
            other.flash_timer = C.FLASH_TIME
            return True
        return False

    def take_damage(self, amount: int):
        self.health -= int(amount)
        if self.health < 0:
            self.health = 0

    def apply_knockback(self, amount: float):
        # Move the rect horizontally by amount pixels
        self.rect.x += int(amount)

    def draw(self, surface: pygame.Surface):
        surface.blit(self.image, self.rect)
        # Draw flash overlay if needed
        if self.flash_timer > 0:
            overlay = pygame.Surface((self.rect.width, self.rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            overlay.fill((255, 255, 255, 160))
            surface.blit(overlay, self.rect)

    def is_alive(self):
        return self.health > 0
